Topic 'Negotiation openings' is covered across 3 course(s): Course-A, Course-B, Course-C.
DISPUTE (opening): Course-A says "Always open with rapport-building small talk." — but Course-B says "Lead with a direct value proposition."
DISPUTE (framing): Course-A says "Frame the conversation around shared goals first." — but Course-C says "State your ask within the first thirty seconds."
